title: CCI approves acquisition of certain shareholding of Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited by Rasmalai Limited
body_text: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) has approved the acquisition of certain shareholding of Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd. by Rasmalai Limited. The proposed combination relates to acquisition of certain shareholding by Rasmalai Limited ( Acquirer ) in Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited ( Target ). The Acquirer is an entity incorporated in Cyprus with the principal activity of holding investments and currently has no activities or presence in India. The Acquirer is indirectly controlled by investment funds managed and/or advised by Advent International, L.P. and/or its affiliates. The Target operates a network of super-specialty hospitals in India, providing comprehensive healthcare services, diagnostics, and advanced medical procedures across multiple specialties. ***** KT/ONP
